details: A recursive teaching plan yields a triangular interpolation basis.
proof: Order the concepts by a recursive teaching plan of width $r=\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal H)$.  For the teaching set $S_i$ of its $i$th concept $h_i$ among the remaining concepts, the product of literals agreeing with $h_i$ on $S_i$ has degree at most $r$, is nonzero at $h_i$, and vanishes at every later $h_j$.  These polynomials give an invertible triangular evaluation matrix, hence a degree-at-most-$r$ interpolation basis.
name: Recursive Teaching Dimension / Interpolation degree
